fusions.name: Drawn Quill
fusions.desc: Plucks one of your own flight feathers and looses it at the first enemy in line for 8 damage. Each use costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Moulting Volley
fusions.desc: Shakes loose 3 feathers and fires them in a spread, each dealing 5 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fence-Post Lookout
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Barbed Fletching
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
